statement_en: Let $x_n:=\sin(n)$. Since the values of $x_n$ are dense in $(-1,1)$, the largest accumulation point is $1$ and the smallest accumulation point is $-1$. Hence $$\limsup_{n\to \infty}x_n=1,\qquad \liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n=-1.$$
